key_cases.holding: The father's challenge to the adoption petition's failure to specify statutory grounds was waived because he never objected below, and his rights were properly terminated on the abandonment ground under § 15-7-7(a)(4).
key_cases.relevance: Kyeshon J. is the Rhode Island authority for terminating a parent's rights inside an adoption proceeding, the route by which many kinship and caregiver permanency plans are finalized, and it shows that objections not raised in Family Court are lost.
key_cases.quote: Accordingly, it is our view that respondent's first contention on appeal has been waived.

key_cases.holding: Because the criminal convictions and life sentences on which the unfitness finding principally rested were vacated while the appeal was pending, the termination decree was vacated and the case remanded for further proceedings.
key_cases.relevance: The competing adoption and relative-placement options in the case show how Rhode Island courts choose among permanency paths.
key_cases.quote: we vacate the decree terminating the respondent's parental rights with respect to Izabella and remand this case to the Family Court for further proceedings as expeditiously as practicable
